svg.title: Copper socket elbow production geometry: 90 degrees, 45 degrees and inserted tube
svg.desc: Offline orthographic render of the actual production compileCopperSocketElbowRoute and buildCopperSocketElbowMesh outputs. Published manufacturer scalar dimensions are used; swage contours are schematic. The example straight tube is an inspection fixture. This is a geometry review, not a certified installation drawing.
